shortDescription: Add a satellite node to an existing VxRail Cluster

options.name: api_version_number
options.description: A specific version number to use for the API call. If not included, will use the highest version by default

options.name: current_root_password
options.description: The root password for the ESX Host.

options.name: dns_server
options.description: An array of dns servers information for the host components

options.name: domain_name
options.description: The domain name for the ESX Host.

options.name: folder_id
options.description: The specific folder id

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname for the ESX Host.

options.name: mgt_account
options.description: Management account the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: mgt_gateway
options.description: Gateway of the component.

options.name: mgt_ip
options.description: The management IP address for the ESX Host.

options.name: mgt_netmask
options.description: Netmask of the component.

options.name: mgt_passwd
options.description: The password for the Management account

options.name: mgt_vlan
options.description: The management vlan id for the ESX Host.

options.name: network_ip
options.description: The network IP address for the ESX Host.

options.name: ntp_server
options.description: An array of ntp servers information for the host components

options.name: order_number
options.description: The position of the node in the rack,the default value is 5

options.name: rack_name
options.description: The name of the rack that houses the host,the default value is default-rack

options.name: root_account
options.description: Root account the VxRail root user is registered to

options.name: root_passwd
options.description: The password for the root account

options.name: syslog_server
options.description: An array of syslog servers information for the host components

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for satellite node expansion, the default value is 1800 seconds

options.name: vcadmin
options.description: Administrative account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vcpasswd
options.description: The password for the administrator account provided in vcadmin

options.name: vxm_version
options.description: The version of the VxRail Manager System.

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System
